tasks.name: commit-linter
args: $msg = Get-Content ${args}; if ($msg -notmatch '^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert)(\(.+\))?: .+$') { Write-Host '❌ ERROR: Invalid commit message format.' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host 'Please use Conventional Commits (e.g., feat: message, fix: message).'; exit 1 }
